title: powerops manifest --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops manifest --format json': the manifest of one path, or of two folders (old first) with their comparison.

path.description: The path as given on the command line.

digest.description: For a folder, the SHA-256 of its file lines; for a zip, the SHA-256 of the zip's bytes.

files.description: The files of a folder in ordinal order of path; always empty for a zip, whose entries are not listed.

path.description: Path inside the folder, with / on every OS.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file (line endings evened out), lowercase hex.

comparison.description: Present only when two folders were given.

added.description: Paths only in the second folder.

removed.description: Paths only in the first folder.

changed.description: Paths in both whose hash differs.

same.description: How many files are the same.
